development_evidence.population: opened ORN v3 + opened ORN v4 + opened ORN v5 lockboxes after ORN v6 freeze

version_rationale.earlier_version: ORN v5 mel candidate used min_confidence 0.72 with softer boundary/rearticulation thresholds after a recall-oriented grid on opened v3+v4.
version_rationale.earlier_limitation: On sealed v5 the recall-oriented choice over-predicted (6985 vs 6622) and precision fell to 0.765784, so lockbox F1 was 0.786213.
version_rationale.later_change: After sealing v6, run a precision-stable mel decode grid on pooled opened v3+v4+v5; select min_confidence 0.75 with default decode thresholds (no soft-boundary overrides).
version_rationale.comparable_result: Pooled development F1 0.802877 with precision 0.819453 and recall 0.786959 on 364 opened rows.
version_rationale.status: frozen for one-shot ORN v6 evaluation; no ORN v6 target or key has been read
